predictions.rationale: Primary HTTP API endpoint that exposes basket operations such as add, remove, update quantity and checkout; directly implements the feature.
Core persistence logic for shopping baskets stored in Redis; supports all basket CRUD operations used by the controller.
Domain model representing a buyer’s basket; manipulated by repository and controller for add/update/remove actions.
Represents individual items within a basket; essential for quantity updates and removals.
Model used when the basket is checked out to create an order; integral to the checkout part of the feature.
Abstraction defining basket persistence operations; directly supports feature implementation across services.
BFF service that forwards web client requests to Basket API; refines and integrates basket feature for web front-end.
Analogous to web BFF but tailored for mobile gateway; supports basket feature for mobile clients.
MVC client-side service that interacts with BFF/Basket API to present and modify the basket in the UI.
Handles checkout integration event to transition basket into order workflow; directly supports checkout aspect of the feature.
